caseTitle: Booky companion size restores from the native preference port after reload

config.grep: Booky companion size restores from the native preference port after reload$

fixture.storage: Existing Node-owned preferenceMemory Map and page.exposeBinding, forwarded by the real Android adapter. No direct preference mutation or reseeding after reload.

productContract.statusQualification: The ready status paragraph is attached but empty; do not require :visible or add success text.

proof: Seed future-size through the existing preferences option, require a read failure and the genuine RU notice, preserve raw bytes and forbid automatic size-key writes; capture the actual 44px retry control.
Tap the real retry, observe a fresh port get and unchanged future-size/no writes; explicitly choose the already-selected Normal to repair the record and confirm stored normal/ready.
Choose Large through genuine controls, confirm actual port set followed by get/readback and ready state.
Use real Hide and await saved existing visibility false before reload so unchanged nativeRootReady retains its one-document-canvas contract.
Reload on the same Page/preference port, wait for the real native root and capture a NEW scene baseline; do not compare objects or camera pose across documents.
Show Large in RU and EN, assert 80px, exactly one pressed size choice, ready state and retained stored value; take two restored screenshots in addition to the earlier read-failure screenshot.
Hide the decorative companion before retained(newScene), switch RU/EN/RU with real Menu controls and preserve country/hash and the same post-reload canonical globe.
captureQualification: Three intentional unique primary images plus the unchanged existing automatic afterEach final capture. Playwright attachment copies are duplicates and must not be counted as extra photographs.
failureScope: Unknown saved-value read failure and genuine read retry are covered using existing fixture preferences. Other read/write failures remain unit/port tests. No failure hook, Map monkeypatch or broader fixture option is added.
qualification: Actual app source browser fixture with a simulated native preference port. No installed PWA/APK, physical OS-storage, cross-start device or full visual acceptance claim; scene identity is compared only within the reloaded document.
